<function=python>
<parameter=code>
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':38},{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':50}])
print(r.get('board_changed'), r.get('level_completed'), r.get('done'))
f=current_frame
def dots(f):
    pts=set((rr,cc) for rr in range(6,58) for cc in range(4,60) if f.ascii.splitlines()[rr][cc]=='N')
    out=[]
    while pts:
        p=pts.pop(); q=[p]; comp=[p]
        while q:
            a,b=q.pop()
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (a+dr,b+dc) in pts: pts.remove((a+dr,b+dc)); q.append((a+dr,b+dc)); comp.append((a+dr,b+dc))
        out.append((min(x for x,y in comp),max(x for x,y in comp),min(y for x,y in comp),max(y for x,y in comp)))
    return sorted(out)
print('dots now:', dots(f))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
